title: Bigg Boss 19's Farrhana Bhatt Says Armaan Malik Is Her 'Favourite': 'Mujhe Nahi Pata Kaise Bolna Chahiye But...' | Television News - News18
text: Salman Khan-hosted Bigg Boss 19 is nearing its end, and to encourage the housemates, the Colors TV show has started the family week. Fans are already witnessing deeply emotional moments. Arguments and tasks have taken a backseat as parents, siblings and loved ones enter the house, bringing laughter and emotions. In the last episode, Farrhana Bhatt’s mother and Amaal Mallik’s brother, Armaan Malik, surprised them with a visit. From teary reunions to bursts of laughter, the episode had it all. One highlight from the show was Farrhana telling Armaan that she is a big fan of his. Farrhana Bhatt Says Armaan Malik Is Her Favourite After Armaan Malik’s emotional reunion, the mood gradually shifted to a lighter one. During this time, Farrhana confessed her love for Armaan Malik’s songs. She said, “It doesn’t matter what, but he is my favourite. Mujhe nahi pata kaise bolna chahiye, but you (Armaan) are my favourite. All your songs, I love them." To this, Armaan responded, “Thank you so much." Farrhana Bhatt Didn’t Know Armaan and Amaal Mallik Are Brothers She even shared that initially she did not believe that Amaal and Armaan are siblings. She said, “Pehle pehle mujhe secret room mein laga ki jhoot bol rahe hain." Amaal asked, “Kya jhoot bol rahe hain?" before Armaan quipped, “Ki main tera bhai aur tu mera bhai hai." This comment left everyone in splits. Armaan And Amaal’s Emotional Reunion Bigg Boss instructed Amaal Mallik to “freeze" for a task just as his brother, singer Armaan Malik, entered the house singing his popular track Kaun Tujhe. Armaan hugged him tightly while Amaal stood still. The mix of the song and the unexpected sight of his brother overwhelmed Amaal, who began tearing up even before he was allowed to move. A few moments later, Bigg Boss announced, “Amaal, release," and the brothers shared a long, emotional hug as Amaal wiped away his tears. Bigg Boss 19 Family Week As Bigg Boss 19 approaches its grand finale, only nine contestants remain in the house. Amid the rising tension, the unexpected arrival of family members is bringing warmth, raw emotions and refreshing moments that temporarily overshadow the usual politics of the game. The contestants still going strong in the competition are Gaurav Khanna, Amaal Mallik, Farrhana Bhatt, Shehbaz Badesha, Tanya Mittal, Malti Chahar, Kunickaa Sadanand, Ashnoor Kaur and Pranit More.
